Financial year runs Apr–Mar. Each month shows the selected years side by side (newest first); YTD columns total each year across all 12 months. The bottom row totals every column. Use the Branch dropdown above to view a single branch (or, for branch users, your own branches) — it also respects the active zone, sub-brand, document-type and segment filters (the global date filter is ignored so multiple years can be compared). Sales are attributed by Document Date, except Credit Notes, Debit Notes and Sales Returns, which are attributed by their Posting Date. Prior financial years are read from the Supabase table "DUROPLY".sales_data: the FY comes from its financial_year column, the month from posting_date, and each customer is matched by Customer Code. They respect the same branch, zone, sub-brand, document-type and segment filters as the current year. Combination of Amount and Volume (V272): tick it to see one financial year at a time, with Pcs and Amount (Basic Amount, ₹ in Lacs) side by side for every month and for the YTD. The Select metrics dropdown and the year checkboxes are not used in this view.

13 Weeks Moving Average of Sales
Weekly Sales(Amt in Lacs Rupees), Sunday–Saturday (from Posting Date) — Last 13 Weeks
Click any point on the chart to see the Document Type summary for that week. Click a row of that summary to see the documents behind it.
Figures in ₹ Lacs, based on Basic Amount (Pre-GST). Weeks run Sunday through Saturday. The most recent week may be partial if data does not yet cover the full week. The sidebar's From/To date range selects which weeks are shown; the 13-week moving average still reads the 12 preceding weeks from outside that range so it stays a true trailing average. The branch / zone / sub-brand / document-type dropdowns are not applied here (the mandatory branch-security scope for non-admin users always is). Click a point on the chart for that week's Document Type summary, then a summary row for the documents behind it. The chart and the Document Type summary are in ₹ Lacs; only the document-level table shows Basic Amount in full Rupees. The PDF export still carries the full weekly series.
13 Months Moving Average of Sales
Monthly Sales (Amt in Lacs Rupees), Calendar Months (from Posting Date) — Last 13 Months
Click any point on the chart to see the Document Type summary for that month. Click a row of that summary to see the documents behind it.
Figures in ₹ Lacs, based on Basic Amount (Pre-GST), by calendar month of Posting Date. The current financial year comes from the live Sales table; earlier months come from the Supabase table "DUROPLY".sales_data (FY from financial_year, month from posting_date). The sidebar To Date sets the last month shown; the From Date is not applied here, because 13 months always reach back before the start of the financial year. The 13-month moving average for each month is the average of that month and the 12 months before it, and shows NA where fewer than 13 months of data exist. The latest month may be partial. The branch / zone / sub-brand / document-type dropdowns are not applied here (the mandatory branch-security scope for non-admin users always is). Click a point on the chart for that month's Document Type summary, then a summary row for the documents behind it; for prior-year months these are read from sales_data when you click. The Document Type summary is in ₹ Lacs; the document-level table shows Basic Amount in full Rupees.
